items.description: Clothing and jewellery stolen from the car
items.rationale: Per 3.1.4 and 4.3(d), loss of or damage to property taken away by a third party is not covered, regardless of means or location, and personal belongings (clothing, jewellery) are not insured property under this residential dwelling policy. Reference Case 31 and others confirm t = 0 for theft of personal effects.

Vehicle-related costs are not insured property (4.3(e)), nor are they an insured cost under 5.1 or 5.2.5. Reference cases (e.g., 30, 26, 24, 23) confirm t = 0 for any vehicle or journey-related expenditure.
